title: AETHER common definitions
description: Shared primitives, JSON-RPC 2.0 envelopes, the error model and payloads reused across layers. CONVENTIONS: (1) The $id host is a non-resolvable identifier (.invalid, RFC 6761). Tools MUST resolve every $ref against this proto/schemas directory and MUST NOT fetch anything over the network. (2) Every request carries params._meta; trace_id is mandatory. Turn-scoped requests use TurnMeta. (3) x-aether-methods, present in each schema file that owns methods, is the routing contract: each route names a server that implements the method and the peers allowed to reach it there. A client sends a method only to a route whose peers include that client. For notifications, peers are the clients that receive the notification from the server. A gateway forwards a method only if some route lists 'gateway' as a peer. (4) Only keywords supported by typify, datamodel-code-generator and json-schema-to-typescript are used: no if/then/else, no not, no dependentRequired, no unevaluatedProperties. Cross-field rules are stated in descriptions and enforced by the receiving server. (5) Codegen for TypeScript MUST enable unreachableDefinitions so every $defs entry is emitted.

x-aether-error-codes.name: InvalidRequest
x-aether-error-codes.description: Not a valid JSON-RPC 2.0 request object.

x-aether-error-codes.name: MethodNotFound
x-aether-error-codes.description: Unknown method, or no route lists the caller as a peer.

x-aether-error-codes.name: InvalidParams
x-aether-error-codes.description: Params failed schema validation. data.pointer is an RFC 6901 pointer to the offending member.

x-aether-error-codes.name: SandboxViolation
x-aether-error-codes.description: Sandboxed code attempted a forbidden operation.

x-aether-error-codes.name: Unavailable
x-aether-error-codes.description: Upstream socket down, model not loaded, or component starting.

x-aether-error-codes.name: RateLimited
x-aether-error-codes.description: Token bucket or concurrency limit hit. data.retry_after_ms may be set.

x-aether-error-codes.name: PolicyDenied
x-aether-error-codes.description: Toolbus policy refused the call (for example a private-network URL).

x-aether-error-codes.name: BudgetExhausted
x-aether-error-codes.description: Per-turn tool-call budget used up. data.limit is the budget.

x-aether-error-codes.name: Cancelled
x-aether-error-codes.description: Cancelled by the caller, by disconnect or by backpressure.

x-aether-error-codes.name: NotFound
x-aether-error-codes.description: Referenced document, checkpoint, job or turn does not exist.

UnixMs.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC. Bounded to 2^53-1 so JavaScript clients stay exact.

HttpUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL. Loopback, private, link-local and unique-local destinations are rejected by toolbus policy (-32005) unless allow-listed, which prevents model-driven SSRF.

SessionId.description: Identifiers are '<prefix>_<token>'. Generators SHOULD use a 26-character ULID token so ids sort by creation time.

CheckpointId.description: The base model is always ck_base.

Meta.description: Reserved params._meta for requests that are not part of a turn. trace_id keys the append-only audit log.

TurnMeta.description: params._meta for turn-scoped requests: engine.generate and every model-facing tool. Toolbus budgets, deadlines and audit all key off these four fields.

JsonRpcId.description: Request ids are never null. A null id appears only in an error response to a request whose id could not be determined.

JsonRpcMethod.description: Dotted lower_snake method name. The 'rpc.' prefix is reserved by JSON-RPC 2.0 and the codec MUST reject it.

JsonRpcParams.description: Params are always a by-name object, possibly empty of members except _meta. Positional arrays are rejected.

JsonRpcBatchRequest.description: NDJSON framing only. AFRAME never batches.

ErrorData.description: Optional machine-readable detail. Open object: servers MAY add keys.

ErrorObject.description: See x-aether-error-codes for the assigned codes.

SubscribeResult.description: Result of every *.subscribe method. Events then flow as notifications on the same connection.

Channel.description: Wire values 0, 1, 2 in the AFRAME TOKENS frame.

Priority.description: Foreground preempts background in the engine scheduler and always preempts the training lease.

ToolCallEvent.description: The model began a tool call mid-generation.

ToolResultEvent.description: Exactly one of result or error is present: result when ok is true, error when ok is false.

Citation.description: A verified citation. The engine emits one only if chunk_id was retrieved during the current turn. marker is the 1-based index of the distinct source in this turn and appears in the answer text as the literal [^marker].
